summary: Ford-Fulkerson allocated its flow vector using edge_count() but indexed it by edge IDs. Removing edges from a StableGraph leaves gaps, so remaining edge IDs can exceed the vector bounds and cause a panic. Using edge_bound() allocates space for every valid edge index. The fix adds test_ford_fulkerson_stable_graphs in tests/ford_fulkerson.rs, gated by the default-enabled stable_graph feature. No tests were executed.
expected_failure: index out of bounds: the len is 3 but the index is 3
